name: Single In-Flight Async Config Load
prompt: config.js exports createConfig(load), where load() is an async function that fetches config. get() caches the result, but concurrent get() calls before the first load finishes each call load() again, and a failed load is cached forever. Fix it: concurrent get() calls share one in-flight load; once loaded, get() returns the cached value without calling load; if load rejects, every waiting caller gets the rejection and the next get() tries load() again. Keep the names and exports. Run it, then commit.
